purpose: Polos, knitwear, loafers, trousers, cardigans, and heritage accessories for old-money and campus outfit builds.

candidates.title: Polo Ralph Lauren Classic Fit Pique Polo Navy
candidates.fitNotes: Classic fit, ribbed collar and cuffs, Polo pony at chest, 100% pique cotton
candidates.reasonForInclusion: The Polo polo is the single most iconic old-money shirt; navy version is the most versatile colorway

candidates.title: Polo Ralph Lauren Slim Fit Pique Polo White
candidates.fitNotes: Slim fit, ribbed placket, Polo pony embroidery, 100% pique cotton
candidates.reasonForInclusion: White Polo polo bridges vacation and old-money; essential second colorway after navy

candidates.title: G.H. Bass Larson Weejuns Penny Loafer Tan
candidates.fitNotes: Genuine leather penny strap, moc-toe construction, leather outsole, very clean heritage loafer
candidates.reasonForInclusion: G.H. Bass Weejuns invented the American loafer; tan penny loafer is the purest old-money campus shoe

candidates.title: Brunello Cucinelli Cashmere Crew Neck Sweater Oatmeal
candidates.fitNotes: 100% cashmere, relaxed crewneck silhouette, very fine gauge knit, tonal seam details
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Brunello Cucinelli defines luxury old-money knitwear; cashmere crew in oatmeal is the aspirational anchor

candidates.title: J.Crew Classic Merino Wool Cardigan Sweater Navy
candidates.fitNotes: Classic fit, button front, V-neck, 100% merino wool, ribbed cuffs and hem
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Navy merino cardigan is the cornerstone of old-money campus layering; J.Crew is the accessible heritage brand

candidates.title: Gap Slim Fit Khaki Chinos Khaki
candidates.fitNotes: Slim fit, no-iron stretch fabric, flat front, classic five-pocket khaki construction
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Khaki chinos are the foundation of old-money/campus dressing; Gap offers them at the most accessible price

candidates.title: Dockers Alpha Slim Fit Chino Trouser Navy
candidates.fitNotes: Alpha slim through thigh and seat, tapered leg, subtle stretch, flat-front design
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Navy chinos complete the polo + chino old-money campus uniform at an accessible price

candidates.title: Loro Piana Polo Shirt Camel Cashmere
candidates.fitNotes: Baby cashmere or finest merino polo, impeccably slim cut, understated Loro Piana branding
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Loro Piana is the apex of quiet luxury old-money; polo in camel signals supreme taste without ostentation

candidates.title: Burberry The Long Kensington Heritage Trench Coat Honey
candidates.fitNotes: Classic gabardine, storm flap, epaulettes, D-ring belt, Burberry check lining
candidates.reasonForInclusion: The Burberry trench coat is the definitive old-money outer; honey color is the most iconic version

candidates.title: Brooks Brothers Original Fit Oxford OCBD Shirt Blue
candidates.fitNotes: Original fit, non-iron Oxford cloth, button-down collar, single chest pocket
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Brooks Brothers OCBD is the original American prep shirt; blue Oxford is the definitive old-money casual top

candidates.title: Alden Indy Boot Suede Snuff
candidates.fitNotes: Genuine suede, moc-toe, Goodyear welt construction, crepe sole, American made
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Alden Indy is a cult-status heritage boot; fills premium campus/old-money footwear gap

candidates.title: Lacoste L.12.12 Classic Fit Pique Polo Vert
candidates.fitNotes: Classic L.12.12 pique, rubber croc badge, mother-of-pearl buttons, clean minimal ribbing
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Lacoste polo is the European old-money/preppy alternative to Ralph Lauren; green is the signature color

candidates.title: Rolex Datejust 36mm Oyster Bracelet Jubilee Silver
candidates.fitNotes: 36mm Oystersteel case, silver fluted bezel, Oyster bracelet, clean dial with cyclops lens
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Rolex Datejust is the apex old-money watch; aspirational catalog anchor for luxury tier

candidates.title: GANT Rugger Oxford Shirt Navy
candidates.fitNotes: Regular fit, button-down collar, chest pocket, garment washed for softer feel
candidates.reasonForInclusion: GANT is the heritage European preppy brand; Oxford shirt fills the old-money casual top gap alongside Brooks Brothers

candidates.title: Mikimoto Pearl Stud Earrings 8mm White Gold
candidates.fitNotes: 8mm Akoya cultured pearl, 18k white gold setting, exceptional luster, iconic pearl stud silhouette
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Mikimoto pearl studs are the definitive old-money fem accessory; aspirational jewelry anchor

manualReviewNotes: All imageUrls are Google Shopping search intent URLs. Need SearchAPI replacement before catalog integration.
Rolex Datejust at $9,500 is extreme luxury — consider whether Sylistly intends to show aspirational luxury pieces or cap at accessible premium.
Brunello Cucinelli ($1,450), Burberry trench ($2,300), and Loro Piana ($895) define luxury tier — may need a 'luxury' budget tier.
Two Polo Ralph Lauren polo shirts (navy + white) with same price — medium duplicate risk on integration; accept both for color coverage.
G.H. Bass Weejuns and Brooks Brothers OCBD are must-have old-money pieces — prioritize these for early integration.
Mikimoto and Alden fill very specific luxury niches that will make premium outfit builds feel elevated and real.
